proposed_stages.name: authority_and_projection_gate
behavior: Verify the pinned projection path and SHA-256.
Require a future, separate execution authority before any package emission.

proposed_stages.name: allowlist_shape_validation
behavior: Accept only the config/state/action paths in the pinned projection.
Reject additional properties and forbidden recursive keys.
Reject state.actions_taken and state.action_feedback.recovered_count from the M0 projection.

proposed_stages.name: public_value_canonicalization
behavior: Canonicalize field paths, numeric bounds, booleans, bounded enums, and opaque references.
Treat natural_language_request and target.target_value as public metadata only; do not parse them for labels, verdicts, outcomes, or hidden identifiers.
Do not read private evidence, archives, payloads, or external outcome tables.

proposed_stages.name: candidate_claim_record_assembly
behavior: Create candidate records with claim_id null, claim_id_state not_minted, and admission_state not_admitted.
Assign claim_kind only from the public config/alignment/action enum.
Attach the pinned projection reference and sanitized field-path manifest.

proposed_stages.name: sanitized_manifest_and_hash
behavior: Emit counts, allowlisted field paths, projection SHA-256, and a package content hash only.
Do not emit raw private paths, labels, verdicts, realized outcomes, credentials, or secrets.

proposed_stages.name: fail_closed_status
behavior: Keep kernel_state=pending_kernel_schema until a separately approved schema exists.
Keep claim_id_state=not_minted and admission_state=not_admitted in this draft-only phase.
Reject rather than partially emit on any authority or forbidden-field failure.

future_strategy.proposed_derivation: HMAC-SHA-256 with an authority-provided namespace secret, encoded as a non-semantic clm_ identifier.
prohibitions: Never derive an ID directly from labels, verdicts, attack/technique classes, hidden/recoverable claims, realized outcomes, raw paths, or payload bytes.
Never mint IDs without a separately signed/recorded execute authority.
Never treat an opaque ID as source role, lineage, quota, credit, or L2 approval.

claim_id_minting_design.emission_before_execute_authority: No Claim IDs are emitted; claim_id remains null and claim_id_state remains not_minted.

output_state_contract.semantic_guard: pending_kernel_schema is a blocking state value only, not an execution or ingestion authorization.

input_constraints: Uses only pinned project05_depth2_public config/state/action fields.
Contains no labels, verdicts, hidden/recoverable/required claim IDs, oracle data, mask membership, or realized outcomes.

fixture_specifications.injected_violation: oracle, oracle_path, mask_strategy, mask_intensity, mask_membership, or random_seed

fail_closed_rules: No schema file is created or published by this design.
No compiler code is created or executed by this design.
No Claim ID is minted until a separate execute authority is granted.
No certificate, Checker, E_case, Promote, STOP, catalog, source-role, credit, quota, or L2 state is written.
Any hash mismatch, unknown field, forbidden token, authority absence, or cross-surface join causes rejection.
